criteria.classification: hard or final no-worse/retention violation REJECTED; otherwise v1 Pareto improvement SCREENING_IMPROVED; other TRADEOFF_ONLY
criteria.comparison: each desired-input-defined speed/sign/magnitude/phase cell; exact IEEE <=; no weighted sum
criteria.development_high: each HIGH cell no worse than baseline
criteria.development_low_mid: each LOW/MID cell no worse than v1
criteria.evaluation: report only after selection receipt frozen; no reselection
criteria.lag: diagnostic only, never physical delay estimate
criteria.pose: observer excursion diagnostic only, never lane score
criteria.selection: Pareto among eligible development vectors; tie smaller factor fraction, smaller friction fraction, config SHA

family.cp_anchor: initial common CP wire factor/friction; all tables built and frozen before execution
family.interpolation: piecewise linear, native speed and parameters float32 admission
family.name: NATIVE_HIGH_SPEED_PARAMETER_DELTA_ATTENUATION_V2
family.reset_policy: fresh isolated controller and plant for each repeat; retain stock inactive/pressed state

hard_constraints: synthetic owned inputs only/no private publication
historical_exposure: original thirteen were seen in v1 attribution; evaluation role is not an untouched holdout

cp_friction_fraction.basis: common software CP compensation, not plant physical friction; tables reanchored before freeze

curvature_gain_fraction.basis: small local dyadic sensitivity; existing A1 fractional coordinate

initial_pose_y_m.basis: small software observer offset, not lane geometry; no controller pose input

initial_yaw_rad_s.basis: nominal speed times small curvature excitation

roll_rad.basis: one tenth existing plant unit-test roll .02

speed_delta_mps.basis: local one m/s within frozen 3..27 domain, not empirical uncertainty

yaw_ar_delta.basis: small local dyadic sensitivity inside existing AR stability domain

robustness.design: nominal plus deterministic one-at-a-time pairs; not calibrated uncertainty/coverage
